  "description": "Logirate is a technology-driven platform focused on improving driver reliability, safety, and performance through data-driven ratings and insights. We are building solutions that help businesses make better decisions about drivers and mobility operations.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Business Development Manager (BDM)&nbsp;

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Technology / SaaS / Mobility

Summary


	We are looking for a Business Development Manager (BDM) to drive business growth, build strategic partnerships, and expand Logirate&rsquo;s customer base.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and develop new business opportunities across target markets and industries.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients.
	Develop and execute business development strategies to achieve revenue and growth targets.
	Generate leads through networking, referrals, research, partnerships, and direct outreach.
	Conduct product presentations and demonstrations to prospective clients.
	Understand clients&rsquo; business needs and position Logirate&rsquo;s solutions accordingly.
	Prepare proposals, negotiate commercial terms, and support the closing of deals.
	Build strategic partnerships with companies, fleet operators, logistics businesses, transport companies, and other relevant stakeholders.
	Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and emerging opportunities.
	Maintain accurate records of leads, prospects, opportunities, and sales activities.
	Collaborate with the product, operations, and marketing teams to improve customer acquisition and retention.
	Provide regular reports on business development activities, pipeline, conversions, and revenue.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Number and value of qualified leads generated.
	New clients acquired.
	Revenue generated from new business.
	Partnership opportunities secured.
	Lead-to-client conversion rate.
	Client retention and account growth.
	Achievement of monthly and quarterly business development targets.


Requirements


	Bachelor&rsquo;s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related field.
	2&ndash;5 years of experience in business development, sales, partnerships, or a related role.
	Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales/business development targets.
	Strong understanding of B2B sales and relationship management.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and networking skills.
	Ability to identify opportunities and convert prospects into paying customers.
	Strong commercial awareness and problem-solving abilities.
	Comfortable working in a fast-paced technology/startup environment.
	Experience in SaaS, fintech, mobility, logistics, transportation, or technology is an added advantage.


What We Offer


	Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
	Opportunity to work with a growing technology company.
	Career growth and professional development opportunities.
	Exposure to innovative solutions in the mobility and technology space.
	Collaborative and dynamic work environment.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a brief cover letter to: sales@masonatlantic.com using &quot;Application &ndash; Business Development Manager (Logirate)&quot; as the subject of the email.",

Business Development Manager (BDM) Job at Logirate




        
    

        
        Logirate is a technology-driven platform focused on improving driver reliability, safety, and performance through data-driven ratings and insights. We are building solutions that help businesses make better decisions about drivers and mobility operations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Business Development Manager (BDM) 

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Technology / SaaS / Mobility

Summary
     

            
    




	We are looking for a Business Development Manager (BDM) to drive business growth, build strategic partnerships, and expand Logirate’s customer base.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and develop new business opportunities across target markets and industries.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients.
	Develop and execute business development strategies to achieve revenue and growth targets.
	Generate leads through networking, referrals, research, partnerships, and direct outreach.
	Conduct product presentations and demonstrations to prospective clients.
	Understand clients’ business needs and position Logirate’s solutions accordingly.
	Prepare proposals, negotiate commercial terms, and support the closing of deals.
	Build strategic partnerships with companies, fleet operators, logistics businesses, transport companies, and other relevant stakeholders.
	Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and emerging opportunities.
	Maintain accurate records of leads, prospects, opportunities, and sales activities.
	Collaborate with the product, operations, and marketing teams to improve customer acquisition and retention.
	Provide regular reports on business development activities, pipeline, conversions, and revenue.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Number and value of qualified leads generated.
	New clients acquired.
	Revenue generated from new business.
	Partnership opportunities secured.
	Lead-to-client conversion rate.
	Client retention and account growth.
	Achievement of monthly and quarterly business development targets.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related field.
	2–5 years of experience in business development, sales, partnerships, or a related role.
	Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales/business development targets.
	Strong understanding of B2B sales and relationship management.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and networking skills.
	Ability to identify opportunities and convert prospects into paying customers.
	Strong commercial awareness and problem-solving abilities.
	Comfortable working in a fast-paced technology/startup environment.
	Experience in SaaS, fintech, mobility, logistics, transportation, or technology is an added advantage.


What We Offer


	Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
	Opportunity to work with a growing technology company.
	Career growth and professional development opportunities.
	Exposure to innovative solutions in the mobility and technology space.
	Collaborative and dynamic work environment.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a brief cover letter to: [email protected] using "Application – Business Development Manager (Logirate)" as the subject of the email.

Background Check / Verification Specialist Job at ResumeSurge Consulting




        
    

        
        ResumeSurge - we connect ambitious businesses with exceptional talent. We are a forward-thinking recruitment consultancy dedicated to helping companies find the right people to drive their success — and helping skilled professionals find the right opportunities to advance their careers. 

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Background Check / Verification Specialist
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced Background Check Officer to join our team.
	The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 3 years of experience in background verification, due diligence, or risk assessment, preferably gained within aconsulting or professional services firm.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting comprehensive background checks, verifying candidate information, ensuring compliance with client and regulatory requirements, and delivering accurate, timely reports.


Key Responsibilities


	Conduct pre-employment background checks, including employment, education, criminal, identity, address, and reference verifications.
	Perform due diligence investigations for clients across multiple industries.
	Verify information provided by candidates through direct engagement with employers, educational institutions, regulatory bodies, and other relevant sources.
	Analyze verification findings and prepare detailed, accurate, and timely reports.
	Escalate discrepancies, adverse findings, or high-risk cases to management.
	Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and company policies throughout the verification process.
	Maintain confidentiality and integrity while handling sensitive information.
	Manage multiple verification cases simultaneously while meeting agreed service level agreements (SLAs).
	Liaise with clients to clarify verification requirements and provide status updates.
	Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process enhancements and best practices.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Criminology, Law, Social Sciences, or a related field.
	Minimum of 3 years of experience in background screening, due diligence, compliance, or employee verification.
	Previous experience in a consulting firm is mandatory.
	Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent report writing and documentation skills.
	High attention to detail with the ability to identify inconsistencies and potential risks.
	Strong verbal and written communication skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
	Ability to manage confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
	Strong organizational skills and the ability to work under pressure while meeting deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications:


	Experience conducting executive-level background investigations.
	Knowledge of regulatory compliance and data privacy requirements.
	Professional certification in HR, compliance, investigations, or risk management is an added advantage.





Compensation


	Salary: N450,000 – N500,000 per month (depending on experience and qualifications).
